adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when the refreshed token response lacks `refresh_token`. This is then used by callers that merge/spread the parsed `data` into existing credentials. For example in `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenResponse = parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, ...)` is followed by `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which will overwrite the real stored `refresh_token` with the literal string when Microsoft does not return a refresh token on refresh (a common case), and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update`. That would corrupt the stored refresh token and break subsequent refreshes.
